## 📚 Academic Publications

### CEP4HFP: Complex Event Processing for Heart Failure Prediction
**IEEE Transactions on Nanobioscience, Vol. 16, No. 8** | December 2017
- **Authors**: Afef Mdhaffar, Ismael Bouassida Rodriguez, Khalil Charfi, Leila Abid, and Bernd Freisleben
- **Abstract**: Novel health analysis approach for heart failure prediction using Complex Event Processing (CEP) technology combined with statistical approaches. Features automatic threshold computation and updates based on historical data.
- **Link**: https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/8094944
